prover.name: lean-auto-duper
prover.declarations: open Lean Auto in @[rebind Auto.Native.solverFunc] def Auto.duperRaw (lemmas : Array Lemma) (_inhs : Array Lemma) : MetaM Expr := do let formulas : Array (Expr × Expr × Array Name × Bool) ← lemmas.mapM (fun ⟨⟨proof, ty, _⟩, _⟩ => do return (ty, ← Meta.mkAppM ``eq_true #[proof], #[], true)) Duper.runDuper formulas.toList [] 0
prover.wrapper: fun premises => do let terms : Array Term := premises.map fun name => ⟨mkIdent name⟩ let hints ← terms.mapM fun term => `(Auto.hintelem| $term:term) let hints := #[(← `(Auto.hintelem| *))] ++ hints `(term| by intros set_option auto.native true in set_option auto.smt false in set_option auto.tptp false in auto [$[$hints],*])
